thread:
mina: Quick heads-up: proposing we change SDKs to require explicit route headers by default. Silent fallback is causing mixed quota and bad console charts.

cale: +1 on visibility but we need a safe rollout. customers relying on fallback may see errors.

mina: Plan: add `require_route=true|false` param to SDKs. Release 1 (minor): param added, default=false, emit deprecation warn and telemetry tag `legacy_route_seen`. Release 2 (minor): flip default to true, continue warn for one minor. Release 3 (major): remove legacy path, env escape `REDWOOD_ROUTE_LEGACY=true` remains for emergency.

rafa: For Go: be careful where we mutate headers in transport chain. Add an integration test with flaky retry wrapper to catch init-order issues.

ui-team: Console changes: we'll add a "legacy route" gauge per tenant and a migration card listing top callers. Also plan an admin modal 7 days before flip.

cale: Telemetry: include `shim_applied` boolean and sample first 5k requests per tenant during canary to surface hotspots.

mina: Migration snippets: Python: `client = RedwoodClient(strict_route=True)`. TS: `new Redwood({strictRoute: true})`. Go: `client.WithStrictRoute(true)`.

rafa: Will open PRs for go/ts/python SDKs with tests. Also add CI job to simulate tenant toggles in routing plane.

build-bot: canary pipeline kicked: python@0.49.0-canary and ts@1.13.0-canary.

mina: We'll document k8s env var patch example and provide a tenant-scoped fallback flag on routing infra to map missing headers to `legacy` bucket if needed.

cale: I'll create routing ticket and smoke-test plan, link to docs.

mina: Thanks team — I'll post RFC in #all-hands and schedule a short sync.

rafa: PR links will follow in this thread.

build-bot: CI: ts-sdk build passed, go-sdk queued.
